{
  "verdict": "sampling",
  "cause": "REPEAT_PENALTY_HIGH",
  "fix": {"action": "set_param", "target": "repeat_penalty", "value": "1.0"},
  "rationale": "The request sets repeat_penalty to 2.0, which halves the score of every token already used. In Hindi that hits common words like 'हैं', 'है' and 'होता'. Once 'हैं' had appeared a few times, the model wrote its Urdu-script equivalent 'ہیں۔' and 'अरबوں' instead. The same pressure explains the invented words ('बाष्पन दरशरण अपनाती हूँ') and the odd tense changes ('मिल जाता था', 'होते थे') where the model avoided repeating 'है/हैं'. Temperature is 0 and the start of the reply is fluent, correct Hindi, which points to the penalty growing over the answer rather than Q4_0 damage to the weights. Take repeat_penalty out of the request or set it to 1.0 (at most 1.1) and run it again before thinking about a different quant."
}
